objective: Run the full 6-phase Group Cognition framework over a design question: divergent exploration, clustering, adversarial critique, evidence review, convergent synthesis, and a final recommendation-with-dissent.

steps.objective: Open the divergent-exploration phase for three independent explorers who will each receive the objective directly.
expectedOutputs: A short framing/confirmation note (agent-result.json status, summary)
agent-report.md: a short human-readable framing/confirmation note

branches.objective: Explore unconventional or unexpected approaches to the objective above -- angles a straightforward answer might miss.
expectedOutputs: A divergent exploration finding (agent-result.json status, summary)
agent-report.md: a short human-readable divergent exploration finding

branches.objective: Give a grounded, standard-practice approach to the objective above.
expectedOutputs: A divergent exploration finding (agent-result.json status, summary)
agent-report.md: a short human-readable divergent exploration finding

branches.objective: Actively challenge the premise -- argue for why this might not be as simple as it looks, even if others would disagree.
expectedOutputs: A divergent exploration finding (agent-result.json status, summary)
agent-report.md: a short human-readable divergent exploration finding

steps.objective: Cluster and deduplicate the three explorers' findings into named groups. Explicitly preserve and label any minority/outlier point -- never discard or silently merge a dissenting view.
expectedOutputs: Explicitly labeled minority/outlier candidates preserved, not discarded
agent-report.md: a short human-readable report of named clusters and preserved minority/outlier candidates

steps.objective: Adversarially critique the clustered findings: identify weak/unsupported claims and missing risks.
expectedOutputs: A critique naming weak/unsupported claims and missing risks
agent-report.md: a short human-readable critique naming weak/unsupported claims and missing risks

steps.objective: Audit the critic's critique for which claims are grounded in the objective/context vs. unsupported speculation.
expectedOutputs: A per-claim grounded/unsupported assessment of the critique
agent-report.md: a short human-readable per-claim grounded/unsupported assessment

steps.objective: Synthesize a converged draft across every phase so far. Preserve decision criteria, accepted evidence, unsupported claims, alternatives, risks, and minority/dissenting positions exactly as found -- never infer consensus from branch count alone.
expectedOutputs: A converged draft synthesis preserving dissent and unsupported-claim flags
agent-report.md: a short human-readable converged draft synthesis preserving dissent and unsupported-claim flags

steps.objective: Produce the final recommendation-with-dissent report: decision criteria, accepted evidence, unsupported claims, alternatives, risks, unresolved questions, minority/dissenting positions, missing/failed actors (if any), and a proposed next action.
expectedOutputs: A recommendation-with-dissent report covering all required elements
agent-report.md: a short human-readable recommendation-with-dissent report covering all required elements
